payload.explanation: The diagnostic report identifies session_c240828a4f3c as the sole blocker: it is idle in transaction after executing the same inventory UPDATE, holding the row lock that blocks the business request session_5063deb47a1b. The state report confirms session_c240828a4f3c is project-owned and eligible for rollback_session, while the business request session must not be modified directly. Rolling back the abandoned blocker releases the lock and lets the pending decrement complete; other idle sessions block no one and are left untouched.
